doc: Footsteps (M2-AUD-05; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). FootstepAudio (game/audio/footstep_audio.gd) listens to the field walker: every walk_step_m (below run_above_m_s) or run_step_m of horizontal distance it plays the scene's surface row (surfaces: surface -> an sfx row) at the walker's feet, quieter by walk_db when walking. A walk ends after stop_sec without movement (frames between physics ticks read none) and restarts first_step of a stride in, so the first step lands soon. Moves under still_m per frame are idle jitter; a jump over teleport_m is a warp, not a walk. speed_smooth_sec smooths the pace. scenes: scene -> surface, else default. The movement speeds are game/data/world/field_movement.json's (walk 2.4, run 4.6 m/s). tools/validate_data.py checks the rows and scenes.
